templates.name: Hosted ITFlow - new instance
templates.description: A hosted ITFlow sign-up from itflow.org, from confirming it with them to handing it over. The website raises it with the fill-ins answered.
templates.subject: Hosted ITFlow: [Client] - [Hostname]
templates.details: Hosted ITFlow for [Client] at [Hostname] - [Technicians] technicians in [Region], [Monthly] a month. Time zone [Time zone].

category.name: Onboard Hosting
category.description: A new hosted ITFlow instance, from sign-up to handover

tasks.name: Confirm the details with [Contact] - canned response Hosting: Confirm the details
Convert the lead to a client, add the hosting recurring invoice ([Monthly] a month) and send the first invoice
First invoice paid
Jabali: make their account on the ITFlow Hosted package (PHP exec allowed)
Jabali: add [Hostname] as a domain - mail none, DNS not managed there
DNS: add the A record for [Hostname] on the itflow.app DNS server
DNS: send them the A record for [Hostname] - canned response Hosting: DNS record to add
Jabali: issue the SSL certificate once [Hostname] resolves to the server
Jabali: install ITFlow from Apps with our setup admin, company [Client]
Update it to the latest version - Maintenance > Update
Settings: time zone [Time zone], company details, turn cron on - leave mail for them
Managed Instances: add it for [Client] - [Technicians] seats, automatic updates - and paste its code into Admin > Managed By there
Check it checks in and shows healthy on Managed Instances
Invite [Contact] as an Administrator - Make the invite link
Send the invite link - canned response Hosting: Your ITFlow is ready
Once they have signed in, archive our setup admin
Wrap up - canned response Hosting: All set

fill_ins.name: Address
fill_ins.help: Our domain: a name on itflow.app, and we add the DNS record. Their own domain: they point it at the server.

fill_ins.name: Region
fill_ins.help: The server it goes on - us-east02

fill_ins.name: Technicians
fill_ins.help: The seat limit to set on Managed Instances

fill_ins.name: Monthly
fill_ins.help: What the recurring invoice comes to
